method: ORCHESTRATOR verified all 22 English keys against the pinned data/texts files at freeze and recorded each call's args_order (none); independently read all 22 pairs before the EXECUTOR report; stat/UI names checked against in-file 'stat name' and UI t() entries (Magic=魔力, Character Sheet=角色信息面板, Off Set=副装备, Inventory=物品栏); three contextual-review rounds adjudicated against source.

adjudicated_findings.observation: 将 Golbug 袭击的目的 to send a package through a portal 译成了已完成的结果“将一个‘包裹’送过了传送门”，错误改变了包裹是否已经通过传送门的事件状态。
遗漏整句 This calls for urgency; should you find this Golbug or the portal, please investigate.，丢失了事情紧急以及发现 Golbug 或传送门时应调查的任务指示。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: closing instruction sentence omitted; ORCHESTRATOR held this independently

adjudicated_findings.observation: 源文右键菜单项 Inventory 与术语快照规定的“物品栏”不符：目标写成“查看物品选项”，属于界面名错误。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: menu item name = 物品栏 (in-file Inventory)

adjudicated_findings.observation: 将任务可由执行动作、发现物品或交谈等行为触发（A quest can come from...）误成这些是“任务内容”，改变了任务出现条件与任务要求的关系；末句还遗漏 Beware 的警告，并将 fight with honour（以荣誉的方式战斗）误成“为荣誉而战”。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: quest origin vs content; Beware dropped; 'with honour' = honourably
ORCHESTRATOR-added: target wrapped mid-sentence over 3 lines while the English is one line (line-structure rule).

adjudicated_findings.observation: 将 combat stats 是整个教程的主题（the subject of this entire tutorial）缩小成“本次教程的一个主题”；又把 Accuracy/Defense 的 score 译为“等级”，并将稍后讲解 exact calculation 误成查看“实际的计算结果”，均改变了教程所述范围或机制术语。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: subject of the entire tutorial; score=数值; exact calculation

adjudicated_findings.observation: 源文将调查指令限定为“若找到高尔布格或传送门”；译文删去了这一条件，改成无条件要求调查，改变了任务指令的条件关系。
adjudicated_findings.host_basis: 'should you find…' conditional dropped; the pre-existing message-1 wording (which FIX-1 told the executor to reuse) had the same gap.
